authored_scope:
Supported:
- Fixed background 7, with random distinct foreground colours.
- Grid sides 10..30 by default; explicit sizes 1..30 (synthetic extension).
- Segments in all four orientations with length >= 3.
- Named templates: dot, plus, x, ibeam, hbeam, ring, diamond. Also random bbox-centred 8-connected templates, or explicit offset lists.
- Layouts pair, right, square and apex are enumerated exactly per template, including tight spacings.
- Layouts bent (unaligned distractor pair) and grown (2..5 centres) are sampled with conservative spacing; both are synthetic extensions.
- Prechecks raise ValueError for infeasible controls even when height or width is omitted. These cover pinned points, edge margins, separation, line-halo crossings, layout feasibility and unhashable layouts.

Not supported:
- Overlapping or touching objects.
- Lines passing through or touching a third shape's body.
- Stamps clipped by the grid edge.
- Multiple segments, or more than two foreground colours.
authored_constraints: Exactly two foreground colours, both distinct from background 7
Segment is a single straight 8-connected run of length >= 3
Shapes are identical, bbox-centred, 8-connected, non-collinear (multi-cell), pairwise non-overlapping and not 8-adjacent
Segment never touches any shape in the input
At least one aligned pair of shape centres exists
A connecting line never touches the 8-halo of a third shape unless it passes exactly through that shape's centre
Endpoint stamps lie fully inside the grid and are separated from each other and from all drawn lines
Explicit centres/template/segment controls are honoured exactly or rejected with ValueError
